tables.name: ord_service_execution_unit

checks.ck_seu_count: ordered_units BETWEEN 1 AND 999 AND unit_ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND ordered_units
checks.ck_seu_current: (state='RESERVED' AND current_execution_no IS NOT NULL AND attempt_no>0) OR (state<>'RESERVED' AND current_execution_no IS NULL)
checks.ck_seu_references: (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(tenant_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(tenant_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(tenant_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(unit_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(unit_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(unit_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(entity_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(entity_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(entity_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(store_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(store_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(store_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(source_operation_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(source_operation_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(source_operation_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(order_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(order_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(order_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(sub_order_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(sub_order_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(sub_order_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(source_line_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(source_line_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(source_line_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(task_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(task_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(task_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(work_order_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(work_order_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(work_order_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(binding_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(binding_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(binding_no))) AND (current_execution_no IS NULL OR (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(current_execution_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(current_execution_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(current_execution_no))))

tables.comment: Permanent original manual service unit; no recycling

tables.name: ord_service_execution

checks.ck_sex_revisions: admission_revision>0 AND manual_source_revision>0 AND source_fence_revision>0 AND observation_epoch>=0
checks.ck_sex_json: JSON_VALID(binding_json) AND JSON_TYPE(binding_json)='OBJECT' AND OCTET_LENGTH(binding_json)<=262144 AND JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(binding_json,'all','$.schema','$.binding')=1 AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(binding_json,'$.schema'))='MANUAL_EXECUTION_V1' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(binding_json,'$.binding'))='OBJECT'
checks.ck_sex_outcome: (resource_outcome_no IS NULL AND resource_outcome_hash IS NULL) OR (resource_outcome_no IS NOT NULL AND resource_outcome_hash IS NOT NULL)
checks.ck_sex_started: state NOT IN ('STARTED','STARTED_SUSPENDED','RELEASING','RELEASED','FULFILLED') OR (resource_outcome_no IS NOT NULL AND resource_outcome_hash IS NOT NULL)
checks.ck_sex_retry: next_retry_at IS NULL OR reason_code IS NOT NULL
checks.ck_sex_hashes: binding_hash REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND source_intent_hash REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND prepare_key_hash REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND prepare_action_hash REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND manual_source_hash REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND original_stock_manifest_hash REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND stock_observation_hash REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND resource_command_hash REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND (resource_outcome_hash IS NULL OR resource_outcome_hash REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
checks.ck_sex_references: (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(tenant_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(tenant_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(tenant_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(execution_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(execution_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(execution_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(unit_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(unit_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(unit_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(entity_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(entity_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(entity_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(store_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(store_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(store_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(grant_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(grant_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(grant_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(prepare_action_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(prepare_action_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(prepare_action_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(declaration_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(declaration_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(declaration_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(confirmation_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(confirmation_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(confirmation_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(source_fence_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(source_fence_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(source_fence_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(resource_command_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(resource_command_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(resource_command_no))) AND (resource_outcome_no IS NULL OR (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(resource_outcome_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(resource_outcome_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(resource_outcome_no))))
checks.ck_sex_reason: reason_code IS NULL OR reason_code IN ('SOURCE_UNKNOWN','SOURCE_SUSPENDED','SOURCE_REVISION_CONFLICT','SOURCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH','SOURCE_QUANTITY_EXCEEDED','TASK_CHANGED','PERMANENT_UNIT_CONFLICT','RESOURCE_PLAN_REQUIRED','UNSUPPORTED_TASK_QUANTITY','RESOURCE_EXECUTION_UNAVAILABLE','EXECUTION_SCHEMA_UNAVAILABLE')

tables.comment: Original manual execution attempt and durable observation

checks.ck_sea_revisions: expected_revision>=0 AND observation_epoch>=0 AND (result_revision IS NULL OR result_revision>0)
checks.ck_sea_actor: (kind<>'PREPARE' OR actor_namespace_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (kind<>'OBSERVE' OR actor_namespace_hash IS NULL)
checks.ck_sea_result: (result_state IS NULL AND result_revision IS NULL) OR (result_state IS NOT NULL AND result_revision IS NOT NULL AND result_state IN ('PREPARED','SUSPEND_REQUESTED','STARTED','STARTED_SUSPENDED','RELEASING','RELEASED','FULFILLED'))
checks.ck_sea_proof: (proof_json IS NULL AND proof_hash IS NULL AND kind<>'SOURCE_SUSPEND') OR (proof_json IS NOT NULL AND proof_hash IS NOT NULL AND JSON_VALID(proof_json) AND JSON_TYPE(proof_json)='OBJECT' AND OCTET_LENGTH(proof_json)<=262144 AND JSON_CONTAINS_PATH(proof_json,'all','$.schema','$.binding','$.suspension')=1 AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(proof_json,'$.schema'))='BEAUTY_EXECUTION_SUSPEND_V1' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(proof_json,'$.binding'))='OBJECT' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(proof_json,'$.suspension'))='OBJECT')
checks.ck_sea_hashes: (actor_namespace_hash IS NULL OR actor_namespace_hash REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') AND request_key_hash REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND action_hash REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND (proof_hash IS NULL OR proof_hash REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
checks.ck_sea_references: (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(tenant_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(tenant_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(tenant_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(action_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(action_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(action_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(execution_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(execution_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(execution_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(entity_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(entity_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(entity_no))) AND (CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(store_no))>0 AND CHAR_LENGTH(store_no)=CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(store_no)))

triggers.body:
BEGIN
    IF NOT (BINARY NEW.id <=> BINARY OLD.id) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.tenant_no <=> BINARY OLD.tenant_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.created_at <=> BINARY OLD.created_at) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.created_by <=> BINARY OLD.created_by) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.unit_no <=> BINARY OLD.unit_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.entity_no <=> BINARY OLD.entity_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.store_no <=> BINARY OLD.store_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.caller <=> BINARY OLD.caller) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.source_operation_no <=> BINARY OLD.source_operation_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.order_no <=> BINARY OLD.order_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.sub_order_no <=> BINARY OLD.sub_order_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.source_line_no <=> BINARY OLD.source_line_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.order_item_id <=> BINARY OLD.order_item_id) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.unit_ordinal <=> BINARY OLD.unit_ordinal) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.ordered_units <=> BINARY OLD.ordered_units) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.quantity <=> BINARY OLD.quantity) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.uom <=> BINARY OLD.uom) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.task_no <=> BINARY OLD.task_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.work_order_no <=> BINARY OLD.work_order_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.binding_no <=> BINARY OLD.binding_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.binding_revision <=> BINARY OLD.binding_revision) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.source_identity_hash <=> BINARY OLD.source_identity_hash) THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Manual execution immutable original';
    END IF;
END

trg_sea_immutable
triggers.body:
BEGIN
    IF NOT (BINARY NEW.id <=> BINARY OLD.id) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.tenant_no <=> BINARY OLD.tenant_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.created_at <=> BINARY OLD.created_at) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.created_by <=> BINARY OLD.created_by) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.action_no <=> BINARY OLD.action_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.execution_no <=> BINARY OLD.execution_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.entity_no <=> BINARY OLD.entity_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.store_no <=> BINARY OLD.store_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.kind <=> BINARY OLD.kind) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.actor_namespace_hash <=> BINARY OLD.actor_namespace_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.request_key_hash <=> BINARY OLD.request_key_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.action_hash <=> BINARY OLD.action_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.expected_revision <=> BINARY OLD.expected_revision) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.observation_epoch <=> BINARY OLD.observation_epoch) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.proof_json <=> BINARY OLD.proof_json) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.proof_hash <=> BINARY OLD.proof_hash) THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Manual execution immutable original';
    END IF;
    IF OLD.result_revision IS NOT NULL AND
        (NOT (BINARY NEW.result_state <=> BINARY OLD.result_state) OR
         NOT (NEW.result_revision <=> OLD.result_revision)) THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Manual execution action already finalized';
    END IF;
END
